create.name: Yoga Academy Poznań
create.bio:
Yoga Academy is a yoga school in the centre of Poznań, housed in an old tenement building on Święty Marcin. It opened in 2016, celebrating its tenth birthday with an open day in 2026, and was founded by Mateusz Deker, who met yoga as a child, finished his first teacher course at eighteen and later spent nine months in Mysore practising under R. Sharath Jois, who authorised him to teach both the Primary and Intermediate series of Ashtanga.

Ashtanga sits at the heart of the timetable, taught both as a gentle weekly introduction to the Primary Series and as Mysore-style practice in which each student follows the sequence at their own pace with individual guidance. Around it the school offers vinyasa, hatha and yin classes, meditation, courses for complete beginners, themed workshops and practice trips.

Through its sister project, Yoga Teachers' Academy, the school has trained yoga teachers since 2020, with a 200-hour foundation course, a 300-hour advanced course and shorter further-training modules in subjects such as the Ashtanga second series, yoga nidra and meditation. Ania Olszewska, who helps run the teacher-training programme and is a practising Tibetan Buddhist who trained in Dharamsala, teaches meditation and breathwork and leads an online meditation course rooted in that tradition.

courses.title: 200-hour yoga teacher training (Nauczycielski kurs jogi)
courses.description: Yoga Teachers' Academy's foundation teacher course, taught mostly in person at the Poznań studio over monthly weekend sessions from February to September 2027, covering asana and alignment, anatomy and physiology, teaching method and yoga philosophy, and ending with exams.

courses.title: Yoga Academy class passes
courses.description: Class passes and open memberships for Ashtanga, vinyasa, hatha, yin and meditation classes at the Święty Marcin studio, including a two-week welcome pass for beginners.
courses.price: 2 tygodnie PRIME OPEN 100 zł; 1 miesiąc open 290 zł; jednorazowe wejście 50 zł
